description: Remove a saved product from this buyer's favorites using its product_id from get_favorites, not a basket item_id. Does not remove it from the basket; use remove_cart_item for that. Returns the updated favorites list. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

product_id.description: Internal numeric Vesremont product ID returned by catalog search or a product response, not the SKU/article or a basket item ID.

name: remove_favorite
